geometry_vs_texture_investigation.underlying_geometry_source: Screened Poisson reconstruction from aerial DJI drone hover baseline (128,336 vertices, 253,487 triangles)
geometry_vs_texture_investigation.ground_lettering_fidelity: Preserved sharply via 4096x4096 texture atlas mapping; vertex coloring inherently lacks spatial resolution to resolve fine letters
geometry_vs_texture_investigation.building_facades_and_rooflines: Roof boundaries and courtyard edges follow mesh geometry; vertical wall facades are rounded due to monocular nadir drone telemetry (< 0.10m translation baseline); facades are observed only obliquely from above

distortion_attribution.mesh_geometry: Naturally smoothed roof-to-ground transitions from Poisson meshing without hallucinated cliff walls
distortion_attribution.uv_coordinates: 1:1 conformal mapping to native drone frames with zero texture tearing
distortion_attribution.source_imagery: High-altitude oblique drone footage; vertical walls are largely occluded in true nadir viewpoints
